contract: Default --sandbox inventory is read-only: no target, registry/mutex creation, download, model credential lookup, model request, SQLite or memory startup.
Explicit --sandbox-probe selects the actual Native recovery/preflight/close lifecycle. It runs fixed disposable deny-network checks, not project commands or arbitrary argv.
Use a diagnostic-only workspace-keyed default state area. Explicit --sandbox-state selects a private business state area; no global cleanup scan.
Installed metadata, live capabilities, probe outcome, resource cleanup and production release status are independent fields.
Read-only inventory has no cleanup authority. Authenticated recovery remains in Native, using private durable ownership and process journals.
No journal argv, environment, process output or exception notes are included in inventory. Unknown remains unknown and retains quota/resources.
SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP reuse existing runtime shutdown handling. Repeated signals do not cancel cleanup; incomplete cleanup exit 1 outranks signal exit.
Fresh fixed probe config copies only cleanup policy, denies network and grants no custom roots. It does not certify project network allowlists or extra roots.
No Local fallback, production factory opening, policy relaxation or automatic runtime download.

linux_container_cleanup.observation_command: ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,args; observation ps process excluded from stable inventory

setup_notes: Initial container launch repeated sleep despite the image ENTRYPOINT already being /bin/sleep. It exited before tests; corrected to infinity.

macOS archive contained AppleDouble metadata and preserved private read modes on some test sources. Verification excludes metadata; only container test sources were made readable. No runtime guard or sandbox policy was relaxed.
Installed package verification checks every bot Python and sandbox asset entry against the wheel. The local wheel was separately compared with current source.
Focused, adjacent and full reports overlap; their case counts must not be summed as unique tests.
remaining: Full dynamic dependency attestation and the remaining P0/P1 acceptance gates.
Full S15 crash matrix, including resource/root publication windows and interrupted recursive removal.
macOS observed process ownership may remain unknown; never infer prior cleanup from current absence.
P4 complete tool classification, child/worktree/Git brokers and peripheral paths, including shared host-write coordination.
P5 both-platform S01-S15, ten daily tasks, at least thirty warm samples per class with p50/p95/RSS/CPU and full repository regression.
Production required factory and Native network allowlist remain closed.
